ci.yml.plan-test:
needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'plan-test')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python3 -I ci/tiers-test.py
      - run: python3 -I tools/vectorgen.py --check src/kexvec/kexvec.lu
ci.yml.linux:
needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'linux')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      BURROW_ENGINE: docker
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Cache digest-pinned oracle and toolchain
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            .wolf-bin
            .oracle
          key: burrow-linux-${{ hashFiles('wolf-toolchain.toml', 'burrow-oracle.toml', 'ci/oracle.Containerfile', 'tools/fetch-oracle') }}
      - name: Build own pinned Ubuntu container
        run: tools/in-container true
      - name: Stage digest-pinned toolchain and the OpenSSH oracle
        run: tools/in-container sh -c 'tools/fetch-toolchain && tools/fetch-oracle'
      - name: Vectors regenerate byte for byte
        run: python3 -I tools/vectorgen.py --check src/kexvec/kexvec.lu
      - name: Format and both compiler tiers
        run: tools/in-container sh -c 'tools/check-fmt && tools/build --all'
      - name: Unit rows on the checked machine, native and lupin
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container tools/check-test
      - name: Transport rows against the pinned sshd, native
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container python3 -I tools/check-transport --bin target/native/burrow
      - name: Transport rows against the pinned sshd, release
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container python3 -I tools/check-transport --bin target/release/burrow
      - name: Retain row evidence
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: linux-evidence
          path: |
            target/tests
            target/evidence
ci.yml.macos:
needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'macos')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: tools/fetch-toolchain
      - run: tools/build --all
      - run: tools/check-test
ci.yml.tier:
name: tier ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tier || 'unplanned' }}
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs:
      - plan
      - plan-test
      - linux
      - macos
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 -I ci/tiers.py verdict
